description: Apply Warp Stabilizer VFX to layers (Animation > Warp Stabilizer VFX), or change the one already applied, and set its controls: Result, Smoothness, Method, Preserve Scale, Framing, Auto-scale, Additional Scale, Detailed Analysis, Rolling Shutter Ripple, Crop Less <-> Smooth More, synthesis options, Objective, Target Layer, Track Point Size, Auto-delete Points and Hide Warning Banner. After Effects analyses the layer in the background after the effect is added or its analysis settings change

addNew.description: Add another instance even when the layer already has Warp Stabilizer. Default false: change the existing one

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

cropLessSmoothMore.description: Advanced > Crop Less <-> Smooth More percent

framing.description: Framing: how moving edges are handled

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

method.description: Method: the most complex stabilization allowed

objective.description: Objective: stabilize, reverse, or apply the motion to a target layer

result.description: Result: smooth the camera move or remove it

synthesisEdgeCropping.description: Advanced > Synthesis Edge Cropping, pixels trimmed from each edge

targetLayer.description: Target Layer index for the apply_motion_to_target objectives

name: apply_warp_stabilizer
title: Apply Warp Stabilizer
